passages.provision_quote: Athletic teams or sports designated for "females", "women" or "girls" may not be open to students of the male sex.
passages.note: Chaptered bill text printing the operative provision Martinez voted on; it names no voter.
House Third Reading roll call shows Martinez voting Y; it names no provision text.

rows.reasoning: Martinez voted Y on House Third Reading of SB 1165 (2022), a single-subject bill whose operative text designates teams by biological sex and bars teams designated for "females, women or girls" from students of the male sex, matching the rung text "require transgender athletes to compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth." The bill's own text states it does not restrict participation on male or coed teams, excluding the rung text describing a complete ban from all organized sports.
